card.name: Moreska
card.profile: A traditional sword dance from the town of Korcula on the Adriatic island of the same name (southern Dalmatia). Two groups of male dancers (Moreskanti) - historically Moors vs Christians, later the White King vs the Black King (Moro) - stage a mock battle in seven sword-clashing figures (kolapa) over a captured maiden, the Bula. Accompanied by brass-band music with a score reconstructed by local composer Krsto Odak. Performed on St. Theodore's Day (29 July) and weekly in summer; moreskanti are documented in a Korcula town journal of 1666 (English Wikipedia; Korcula Tourist Board).
card.insight: Korcula is the only place where the Moreska survives with each soldier wielding two real swords, the dance having vanished elsewhere in the Mediterranean by the 19th century (English Wikipedia).
